method: All 133 Poppler-rendered page images were inspected through twelve contact sheets; fifteen representative pages from the two new proof-system chapters, the source-note appendix, and the bibliography were then inspected at readable or enlarged scale.
observations: No clipping, overlap, black boxes, missing glyphs, unreadable formulas, or broken running heads were observed. Dense sequent-calculus and natural-deduction proof trees remain legible and inside the page area. Devanagari shaping, headings, page numbers, source-correction notes, links, and bibliography entries render cleanly. The mostly blank chapter-boundary page 73 and sparse final bibliography page 133 are intentional layout outcomes. Empty squares at proof endings are the intended QED marks.
limitation: Same-agent visual review; not independent linguistic certification.
